The prize money on "Triple Red 7s Multiplier" leans toward the smaller prizes. It is spread over twelve prize levels, from wins equal to the ticket price up to $77,777. Games built like this pay out often, in small amounts. That design never changes, and it is the part you choose.

Everything here about "Triple Red 7s Multiplier" comes from official Maryland lottery numbers, current through October 11.

Everything above about "Triple Red 777s" comes from the Maryland Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
